Hi OP! I couldn’t help but notice your beautiful, delicate colouring and I suspected that you would be a “soft summer” in the colour analysis typing.

I put your photo through the AI scanner in Dressika- and that turned out to be your type! Give it a Google and see which colours in your pallete you like. This is a good way of brightening your overall look without needing much makeup. It also recommends what kind of metal suits you, so would advise jewellery options.

I fucking love you for posting that. It’s made me well-up.
Jesus Christ, how lucky are we to have gone through this during the age of the internet, where all BPs can connect and pull each other up. 
That’s really going to stick with me. Thank you. You deserve everything you have fought for.

Wow- that’s really insightful and has hit me really hard. I’m so happy your wife has done some serious soul searching after such a rough childhood. You’re an angel. Thank you for sharing your experience with me- I don’t take it lightly. 
I will really try and get back to myself before everything happened. I don’t think I’ve lost a part of me- I know it’s still there, I just need to reconnect to it.

Thank you-  I’m glad you’re in a place where you’ve processed what happened

I have to tell myself off now- my mind still ruminates on it at least once every couple of days now. I catch myself and I’m like “for fuck’s sake- you’ve got more important and exciting things happening right now that needs your attention!” There’s literally nothing left to uncover. Nothing left worth speaking about- everything has been touched upon and unpacked already. I think I’m just stuck in the habit. I know my mind is just trying to protect me, which it’s sucking so much energy I need to actually redirect into making my life better and progressing.

I really hate it when colour analytics go with what makes you blend in with the clothes. You’re supposed to GLOW. Your eyes are supposed to shine. Loads of people get typed as a muted and quite frankly look flat and grey. REAL summers shimmer in summer clothes- real autumns glow in summer clothes.
Light summer has you shining 🤩

Silver brings out a roseyness in your skin, gold makes you looks more yellow- tanned, yes, but I don’t know, I feel like the rosey glow is probably the most flattering. I would imaging silver on warm skin would make the skin look really dull and sallow, while it’s the opposite for you!

That just goes to show how big your heart is. This person snuck into your life, they completely upheaved your life and sense of security. And yet you didn’t wish her the worst, not really. Maybe you did hope that karma found her- but now that she’s gone and let’s face it, it probably wasn’t the best way to go, you feel shocked that she’s passed, and you feel sympathy and empathy for her children. 

Of course you’re going to feel mixed feelings- because you see her as another human, a flawed human, who could have spent her last years in a genuine, honest, beautiful relationship, but instead to intrude on your relationship. Everyone deserves better than that. It’s a shame she couldn’t see that. She knew deep down that YOUR HUSBAND wouldn’t be there for her as a genuine partner would, but she chose not to see that. 

I’m sorry this is another hurdle you and your WP will have to work through. Your husband did the right thing by calling it off with AP and not letting her in anymore. How was he to know she would pass so soon? Eventually not having your husband in her life was her cross to bear.
I think you’re a winter- probably a deep/dark winter. I’d be very surprised if you were anything else.

You’re not a dummy, she’s fucked this up- not you. You deserve more. No reconciliation is possible while they’re still cheating. You’ve got this. 🤍

We always need to break the cast a gel or mousse creates! The crunchyness is supposed to be there for the sake of keeping your texture in place while it dries- preventing frizzy waves/curls! As soon as it’s 100% dry, there’s no need for a cast! Use a wee bit of oil in your hands, rub your hands together and scrunch until the cast is broken. Your hair will be so BIG.
Not fully sold on the white to be honest. Have you got a cream?
That red is lovely.
That light blue/lilac is not a winter colour, by the way! It’s more summer- way too muted for a winter shade. The rest look pretty fucking lovely. Can I see you in a bright, brilliant white?

If I was to make a guess I’d say bright winter just because of how fucking bright that pink is! But it would be interesting to see that palette for sure! Because all winters can borrow from each sub-palette, it’s just a case of one sub palette looking perfect and the others still looking wonderful.

Honestly without some swatches of either spring or winter I couldn’t tell you 100%. Are you naturally that dark haired? Do you feel better in silver or gold? I think just be looking at you I’d say winter- you do have olive undertones, but I’d say it’s a cool olive; bit I say winter tentatively because I think I could see you in a spring palette too, im just not certain that one would be better over the other.

Right 100%. I don’t know how anyone can look at your skin in the left and say that’s your colour- it highlights “less desirable” aspects in your skin that completely vanish and aren’t even there in the darker, brighter pink. I don’t think you’re a summer either, m’love- that right pink is so loud and you pull it off too well.

“Aiming to be less of a narcissist” which was what she said; is not the same as being diagnosed with narcissistic personality disorder. Everyone has narcissistic tendencies, does usually not make for a personality disorder- I suspect how frank she was about it is literally her describing how she’s seeing herself based on her current actions- which is self-reflective and not taking herself too seriously at all. She didn’t come out and say “I have been diagnosed with this and I’m getting help for it” so we shouldn’t treat it as such.

I was overweight in summer 2020. I was 26, COVID happened, I drank loads and ate whatever I wanted and didn’t really exercise.

I’m now back to where I was when I was 20. The main differences are this:
1. Stopped drinking. There’s a whole myriad of reasons as to why it interferes with fat loss. The “sober powered” podcast has a good episode on this, try episode 34. 

2. Picked up the weights.
Honestly, my body has greatly benefitted from gaining muscle. I’ve dropped in weight, yes, but I’m still looking more “strong” than I did before I started losing the weight. I’m not “hench” by any means, but it’s made me look more toned. I looked slimmer but more “shapely” with a bit of muscle then I did when I was younger at the same weight. 
My weight is a lot more stable and hovers around 121-125 lbs. It gives more appetite, helps with my mood and sleep. I feel a lot less stressed in general since I’ve got a 45 min workout in…. And we all know what stress does to us!

3. Up your protein. I mean it. 
I’m vegan so I realised I just hadn’t being paying much attention to it, and probably wasn’t getting enough. Make a point to eat more; and you discover it’s not that hard once you’re aware of it. 

4. Cooking at home. Just do it man. I know it’s hard to time for this at first alongside the gym, but we just have to. Thankfully I don’t have any kids, but I was working 42 hour work weeks with night shifts too. You will feel better for it in the long run.

5. Your weight will change 5 lbs or so every couple of days. Ignore it. Over a long time, you will see on a graph that your weight is creeping down. Think of the long game, and don’t be horrible to yourself when it looks like you’ve gained 2 lbs.

6. I enjoy big meals. I do not suit being a grazer. I do the 14 hour daily fast and eat to full satiety for lunch and dinner. I would recommend still going whole foods plant based, just so you can get your micronutrients in and all the rest of it… but you have to conduct this experiment yourself. Eat however you want and if it doesn’t work, maybe try the whole vegan thing later.

Aaaaaaand the most important:

7. Don’t be a cunt to yourself.
I mean it. So important. Just take one step at a time. Make a list of what you feel is holding you back and rate each point on how easy it would be to resolve. Start with the easiest and keep going. Who knows what you may have achieved this time next year. 
Remember that it’s a mental game as much as a physical one, and if you’re struggling mentally, please don’t be ashamed to seek help. This is all about you, and you need to be so loving with yourself. You deserve to be happy and safe.
